## ThrowExceptions {#Sisk_Core_Http_HttpServerConfiguration_ThrowExceptions}

Gets or sets whether the server should throw exceptions instead of reporting it on 
[HttpServerExecutionStatus](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Http.HttpServerExecutionStatus.md) if any is thrown while processing requests.

```csharp
public bool ThrowExceptions { get; set; }
```

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)
